prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset: one original transparent spot illustration for Zingg's "On Your Wavelength" party-game card.
Subject: a squat vintage portable tabletop radio, muted blue body, cream speaker grille with simple broad slots, one large beer-gold tuning knob, tiny red tuning needle behind an unlettered horizontal dial. Its metal antenna is absurdly tied in one large clearly readable loose overhand knot before continuing upward: the single deadpan visual joke. No face, no brains, no characters, no additional props. Slight three-quarter view, compact wide silhouette, all antenna parts in frame. Antenna knot must be clearly legible at 150–180 pixels tall.
Style: match Zingg's approved warm ink / dry jokes style. Confident slightly uneven thick dark brown #2f2118 hand-drawn contours, broad rounded forms, mostly flat muted spot colors, restrained dry screenprint grain inside shapes. Muted blue #6ca6c9, beer gold #f6b33f, small rug red #b9413a accent, cream #fffaf0 details. A respectable simple drawing with one wrong detail; understated, not manic or cute.
Composition: centered isolated object on transparent 4:3 landscape canvas, subject occupies about 80 percent of canvas width and height. Clear silhouette, balanced visual weight, clean alpha edges.
Constraints: genuinely transparent background. No text, letters, numbers, logos, words on radio, scenery, card frame, white sticker border, background texture, paper rectangle, drop shadow, gradients, glossy shading, photorealism, 3D, dense hatching. Do not draw Mind Meld brains or tin-can telephones.
